48819:140812.name: arc/bottom/lrg
48819:140812.description:
Arc Large Bottom is for arc text and labels - at the bottom of a page.

Arc is for text along a curved path on the screen, reserved for short header text strings at the very bottom of the screen like confirmation overlays.

Curved text is tabular/uses mono spacing by default.

47942:129509.name: title/med
47942:129509.description:
Title Medium is the medium title. 

Titles are smaller than Displays. They are typically reserved for medium-emphasis text that is shorter in length and not recommended for interactive components, rather page headings or sub headings.
